title: Rapidata/sora-video-generation-physics-likert-scoring
description:
Rapidata Video Generation Physics Dataset
	









If you get value from this dataset and would like to see more in the future, please consider liking it.


This dataset was collected in ~1 hour using the Rapidata Python API, accessible to anyone and ideal for large scale data annotation.

	
		
	
	
		Overview
	

In this dataset, ~6000 human evaluators were asked to rate AI-generated videos based on if gravity and colisions make sense, without seeing the prompts used to generate them.… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Rapidata/sora-video-generation-physics-likert-scoring.
